meta.title: Garage swing lock — The Heights at Uptown
meta.source: Brandi Williams, OCH — 48-address garage swing list, 15 Oct 2026
meta.convention: L and R are read standing at the street looking at the house, which is how OCH designates a plan and how both tools label the control.

values.L: Garage must be on the left
values.R: Garage must be on the right
values.E: Either side is allowed — stated explicitly on the source list

meta.unlisted: A lot not present in locks has no instruction on file. It behaves as it always has: free choice, no notice printed.
meta.notSetNote: 529 Walker Parkway (N-22) and 525 Walker Parkway (N-23) came through blank on the source list. They are deliberately left out of locks rather than guessed. Add them here when OCH sets them.
meta.alreadyBuilt: Per the source instruction, a lot that is already built can be ignored. The tools do not suppress the lock on built lots — the status file already marks those lots as unavailable, and the lock is harmless there.
meta.override: The lock is a hard default, not a wall. A user can deliberately override it; when they do, the fit sheet prints a notice naming the locked side and the side actually drawn, so an override can never leave the building silently.
meta.scope: This is a streetscape rule on rear-alley lots. It is not the same thing as Grand Oaks' drvReq, which is a driveway-geometry constraint on front-entry lots. No lot carries both.
